newsitem.title: FRANCE: Graveleau opens multi-modal hub in Strasbourg.
newsitem.headline: Graveleau opens multi-modal hub in Strasbourg.

text.p: French road haulage and cargo agent group Graveleau has opened a new transport and distribution hub in Strasbourg.

"Graveleau has invested ten million francs in a 2,500 square metres hub which will serve as a multi- modal hub for international traffic being in close proximity to the A4 motorway, Strasbourg's river port on the Rhine and the city's airport," a Graveleau official told Reuters.

The firm already has a 700 square metre facility near Strasbourg dedicated to domestic traffic, the official added. said. Graveleau's 1995 turnover was 1.3 billion francs, of which seven percent came from its its overseas division (air and sea forwarding) which largely consists of imports to Europe from the Far East, through a partnership agreement with Swedish group ASG AB as well as North America.
